columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: currentLimit
columns.description: Current limit ILS

columns.name: obligoPct
columns.description: Obligo %

columns.name: requestedLimit
columns.description: Requested limit ILS

columns.name: justification
columns.description: Justification (long text)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Request status

columns.name: requestCreatedAt
columns.description: When the request was created

columns.name: triggeredAtPct
columns.description: Insured-limit utilisation % when the proposal was created

columns.name: companyId
columns.description: Company registration number (ח״פ)

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Currency of the request, e.g. ILS

columns.name: insuredLimitAtRequest
columns.description: Insured limit ILS at the time of the request

columns.name: insurerFields
columns.description: What would be sent to the credit insurer (בסס״ח) as an ICIC API quota request, field by field. Nothing is sent: the API connection opens when keys arrive

requestType.description: Always increase (הגדלת מכסה); new-customer requests are not built

value.description: Value that would be sent; null when unknown or missing

status.description: מהנתונים = taken from the customer card or reports; קבוע = constant; חסר = the source field is empty; לא ידוע = not yet known (to clarify with Yaniv)

source.description: Where the value comes from, in Hebrew

note.description: Hebrew note, e.g. לא ידוע – לברר עם יניב

missingFields.description: Names of fields with status חסר or לא ידוע

columns.name: assignedBookkeeperName
columns.description: Bookkeeper who owns the customer (display name)

columns.name: proposedBy
columns.description: Who proposed the increase (agent display name or person)

columns.name: decidedBy
columns.description: Who approved or rejected the proposal

columns.name: decidedAt
columns.description: When the proposal was decided

columns.name: submittedAt
columns.description: When the request was submitted to the insurer

columns.name: approvedAmount
columns.description: Amount approved by the insurer ILS

columns.name: insurerCaseNumber
columns.description: Insurer case number

columns.name: insurerResponseNote
columns.description: Insurer response note

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
